body.name: phaseplug
body.construction: Estimate only \(\gamma\) by \(\widehat\gamma_n\), use the observed aspect ratio \(p_n/n\), and treat \(\lambda\) and \(R\) as fixed; compute \(\widehat\xi_n=(p_n/n,\widehat\gamma_n,\lambda,R)\), \(\widehat b_n=b^\star(\widehat\xi_n)\), and the four coordinates \(\widehat d_{\ell n}=d_\ell(\widehat\xi_n)\) for \(\ell\in\{\mathrm{bal},\mathrm{rad},\mathrm{col},0\}\); set \(\widehat\Delta_n=\lambda\{g(\rho_T(\widehat b_n;\widehat\xi_n))-g(\rho_E(\widehat b_n;\widehat\xi_n))\}\) when \(\widehat b_n\ne\bot\) and set \(\widehat\Delta_n=0\) otherwise; define the total output by \(\widehat s_{n,\alpha}=\operatorname{sgn}(\widehat\Delta_n)\) if \(\widehat b_n\ne\bot\) and \(\min_\ell\widehat d_{\ell n}>\widehat u_{n,1-\alpha}\), and \(\widehat s_{n,\alpha}=\bot\) otherwise
